name: Palm Beach County, FL
findings: Palm Beach County has 6,506 nonprofit organizations. 1,943 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,500 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Palm Beach County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few arts and cultural organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 20 arts and cultural organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 84 would.
